review_scope: Finite static source/AST and ordinary protocol/SHA review only; prior source review reused and final correction/pins checked. No HF/candidate import, tests, installation, numerical call, plot or scientific/media payload read.
stop_contract: Single invocation, failfast, cooperative stop and original SUP2 ownership/cleanup; retain actual installation and partial evidence, no retry/force/rollback. Scalar plot only after all finite tests pass.
pre_execution_correction: Joint static review found two existing card gates omitted from the accepted-snapshot test loop. Before freeze/any execution, the author added relative_global_force_balance <= 1e-6 and actual fixed-DOF abs(math.fsum((lift,fluctuation))) <= 8e-11 mm. Final source/TEST_MATRIX/protocol pins agree; methods, solves, physical algorithm and tolerances were not changed.
qualification_limit: A source-only review is not a test pass or numerical qualification. Planned tiny compatibility does not qualify actual circle unload, pressure, gripping, release, stability or full path.
